research.name: COBE
research.note: A small WebGL library that draws a dotted globe with markers and arcs, and lets ordinary DOM elements attach to them.

effects: Arcs drawn between locations on the globe
DOM elements with CSS transitions and animations bound to globe markers and arcs through CSS anchor positioning
